## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Describe the use case, not just the
solution you have in mind.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like `lomax` to do. Sketch the CLI surface if relevant
(e.g. `lomax sync <profile> --new-flag`).

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches, workarounds, or existing tools you've tried.

## Scope check

<!-- Tick the boxes that apply so we can triage quickly. -->

- [ ] This is Linux-only (not a request for macOS/Windows support).
- [ ] This is CLI behavior (not a GUI / player / streaming-client request).
- [ ] I checked the [roadmap](../../docs/music-cli-plan.md#15-development-roadmap)
      and this isn't already planned.

## Additional context

Links, prior art (beets/wrtag/etc.), or anything else.
